walk:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production 2D ARPG WALK animation sprite sheet for Vạn Đạo Trường Sinh.
Input image is the approved character identity and elevated top-down-oblique camera reference, NOT an edit target to retain its layout.
Create ONE clean transparent sprite sheet with EXACTLY a 4-column by 4-row grid, sixteen complete separate full-body poses, equal square cells. No grid lines or text.
Rows in order: UP (back facing viewer), LEFT, DOWN (face toward viewer), RIGHT. Every row shows a four-pose walking cycle: left-foot contact, passing stance, right-foot contact, opposite passing stance. Legs really step; knees bend; hips and shoulders counter-rotate slightly; cloth and sleeves follow the motion. This is NOT sixteen copies of one standing pose and NOT a bob/stretch effect.
Preserve the same original youthful adult male sword cultivator: slim readable body, black topknot with muted brass band, dusty blue-gray outer robe with restrained old-gold edge, warm ivory cross-collar and underskirt, deep navy sash and boots, jade-guard straight sword always in anatomical right hand. Same head size, garment, sword length and light direction in every cell. Keep face/eyes visible in down/side views. Top-down camera 35 degrees above, see crown and shoulders. Clean hand-painted pixel-art inspired RPG sprites with deliberate readable shapes and no noisy microdetails.
Each sprite entirely inside its cell, centered feet at the same baseline around 85% of cell height. Each standing figure about 70% cell height, comfortable margin around raised sword and garments. Physical sword tracks the hand correctly in all directions. Fully transparent background, no floor or cast shadow, no aura, no VFX, no labels, no duplicated overlapping figures.
props:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent modular environment sprites for the 2D top-down cultivation ARPG Vạn Đạo Trường Sinh.
Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY (painted pixel-art inspired Vietnamese/Sino-Vietnamese ancient mountain village, mossy blue slate roofs, aged timber, warm stone, muted foliage). Do not reproduce its layout or put a whole scene in this sheet.
Draw exactly SIXTEEN isolated complete individual props arranged on a regular 4 by 4 square grid, one prop per equal cell, generous transparent margins. Elevated 35-degree top-down camera with front visible, same orthographic direction for every object, no perspective vanishing point.
Row 1: large village ancestral hall with mossy dark blue tiled roof and entrance steps; herbalist timber shop with hanging herb bundles; guard barracks with sword rack; small modest tiled-roof house.
Row 2: old Daoist stone-and-timber archway gate; gnarled tall pine tree with irregular canopy and readable trunk; smaller ancient broadleaf tree; large weathered mossy rock cluster.
Row 3: stone lantern with small warm ivory flame; simple wooden training dummy; wooden weapon rack with 3 straight swords; ancient carved stone shrine beneath small weathered roof.
Row 4: closed carved wood treasure chest with brass trim; low leafy medicinal herb patch with tiny white flowers; dark rock with three pale jade mineral crystals; low old stone boundary wall segment.
Complete silhouettes, no clipping, each prop has only its small grounding contact shadow within the same cell. Restrained green, dusty teal roof, stone gray, wood brown, old brass palette. Clean production asset art, rich material planes but avoid noisy detail that disappears at game scale. True transparent background. No ground tiles, no landscape background, no text or labels, no characters, no collage of scenes.
